title: The Spotlight editor opens on your page, with Look and Share on their own tabs

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19 (project thread: Redesign the Spotlight editor): 'The page layout is bad.' Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/WX5fSWaGKNuKhe8iXbPSYf, phase 4.

detail: Six cards (Publish, Theme, Look, Your own links, Clicks, Upgrade) stacked above Your page, so the blocks were six cards down. The Live switch stays on top; under it three tabs: Page (the blocks, opened first), Look (theme and layout) and Share and stats (own links, custom domain, clicks). On a phone the editor and the preview take turns behind an Edit or Preview switch, and a press on the preview brings Edit and the Page tab forward.

verify.note: Fails while the settings cards stack above the page or a phone has no Edit or Preview switch.
